public_body: West Boylston Public Access Tv Board
overall: Resolved by informal action: the AG found the Board violated the Open Meeting Law by approving inaccurate, sparse minutes, but no further relief was ordered because the Board amended the minutes on March 29, 2018.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged the Board failed to create accurate minutes of a meeting; the approved minutes of its December 2017 meeting were sparse and omitted several discussion topics.
allegations.key_passage: We find that the Board's original failure to create accurate minutes of the December 12, 2017 meeting violated the Open Meeting Law.
